# What does this PR do?

Makes `TEGroupedMLP` fail fast when MoE GroupedTensor execution (`moe_use_grouped_tensor=True`, also turned on by `use_transformer_engine_op_fuser`) would run on a cuBLASLt grouped GEMM known to corrupt outputs.

## Problem

cuBLASLt from 13.7.0 up to (not including) 13.8.1 can leave rows of a grouped GEMM output unwritten on Blackwell and Rubin GPUs. The [cuBLAS 13.8.1 patch notes](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cublas-patch-release-notes/#cublas-patch-release-13-8-1) list the fix: grouped GEMM "could produce incorrect results on Blackwell and Rubin GPUs", introduced in 13.7.0. With `moe_use_grouped_tensor=True`, every expert GEMM goes through this path, so the experts silently read stale memory.

We hit this on GB200 with an NGC image that ships cuBLAS 13.7.0.27 (Nemotron 3 Nano MoE, HybridEP):
- intermittent grad-norm spikes (1,000-12,600) and occasional NaN loss at step 1, only with `--moe-use-grouped-tensor`;
- with TE's GEMM outputs filled with NaN instead of `torch.empty`, every run hit a NaN within 3-11 steps. Each traced case was an fc1 forward grouped GEMM with clean inputs and correct split sizes whose output kept NaN in exactly 32 rows of one expert segment;
- a single-GPU repro without Megatron (TE `GroupedLinear(use_grouped_tensor=True)`, the same inputs on every call) leaves 32 rows unwritten in roughly 0.1-0.5% of forward calls.

TE 2.20.2 prints a one-time warning at the first grouped GEMM (`cuBLAS version 130700 has a grouped GEMM bug that may cause data corruption`), but it is easy to miss in a training log, and we missed it.

## Change

- `megatron/core/transformer/moe/experts.py`: new `_check_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_version()`. It is called from `TEGroupedMLP.__init__` after the GTP split-quantize fallback has decided whether grouped-tensor execution is actually used. It raises `RuntimeError` when all of these hold:
  - the current GPU is SM100-SM110 (`torch.cuda.get_device_capability()`);
  - the cuBLASLt loaded at run time (`transformer_engine_torch.get_cublasLt_version()`, i.e. `cublasLtGetVersion()`) is in `[130700, 130801)`, the same range TE warns on.
- Escape hatch: `MCORE_ALLOW_BUGGY_CUBLAS_GROUPED_GEMM=1` downgrades the error to a warning, for example to reproduce the bug or to benchmark.
- The check runs at run time, not in `TransformerConfig`, because config validation cannot see the device or the loaded library.

Example error:

```
RuntimeError: cuBLASLt 13.7.0 grouped GEMM can leave output rows unwritten on Blackwell and Rubin GPUs (this GPU is SM100), which silently corrupts MoE expert outputs with moe_use_grouped_tensor=True (also enabled by use_transformer_engine_op_fuser). Upgrade cuBLAS to 13.8.1 or newer, or disable both options. Set MCORE_ALLOW_BUGGY_CUBLAS_GROUPED_GEMM=1 to downgrade this error to a warning.
```

CI impact: none expected. The dev CI image already installs cuBLAS 13.8.1.7 (#7685), and the LTS image (25.09) predates 13.7.0. Hopper is unaffected.

## Tests

In `tests/unit_tests/transformer/moe/test_grouped_mlp.py`. They mock `torch.cuda.is_available`, `torch.cuda.get_device_capability` and `transformer_engine_torch.get_cublasLt_version`, so no GPU kernels run:
- error on SM100/103/110 with cuBLASLt 13.7.0, 13.7.5 and 13.8.0;
- no error or warning for 13.6.4, 13.8.1 and 13.9.0 on SM100, or for 13.7.0 on SM90 and SM120;
- warning instead of error with `MCORE_ALLOW_BUGGY_CUBLAS_GROUPED_GEMM=1`;
- `TEGroupedMLP` construction raises with grouped tensor, and skips the check when the GTP split-quantize fallback turns grouped tensor off.

Ran locally on CPU torch: the 16 new tests and the existing GTP/paged-stash construction tests pass (22 tests). black, isort, ruff and pylint are clean.

## Contribution process

- [x] Draft PR
- [x] Signed-off-by (DCO)
- [ ] Commit GPG signature (not available on the authoring machine)

@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@
 import functools
 import inspect
 import logging
+import os
 import warnings
 import weakref
 from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable
@@ -245,6 +246,47 @@ def _te_grouped_tensor_supports_sharded_weights() -> bool:
     return "is_dist_weight" in signature.parameters
 
 
+_ALLOW_BUGGY_CUBLAS_GROUPED_GEMM_ENV = "MCORE_ALLOW_BUGGY_CUBLAS_GROUPED_GEMM"
+
+
+def _check_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_version() -> None:
+    """Refuse GroupedTensor execution on a cuBLASLt whose grouped GEMM can corrupt outputs.
+
+    cuBLASLt 13.7.0 up to 13.8.1 can leave rows of a grouped GEMM output unwritten on Blackwell
+    and Rubin (SM100-SM110), so experts silently read stale memory: grad-norm spikes, or NaN when
+    that memory was never written. See
+    https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cublas-patch-release-notes/#cublas-patch-release-13-8-1.
+    TE only warns once at the first grouped GEMM, which is easy to miss in a training log.
+    """
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
+    sm = 10 * major + minor
+    if not 100 <= sm <= 110:
+        return
+    import transformer_engine_torch as tex
+
+    # The cuBLASLt library loaded at run time, versioned as major * 10000 + minor * 100 + patch.
+    version = tex.get_cublasLt_version()
+    if not 130700 <= version < 130801:
+        return
+    message = (
+        f"cuBLASLt {version // 10000}.{version // 100 % 100}.{version % 100} grouped GEMM can "
+        f"leave output rows unwritten on Blackwell and Rubin GPUs (this GPU is SM{sm}), which "
+        "silently corrupts MoE expert outputs with moe_use_grouped_tensor=True (also enabled by "
+        "use_transformer_engine_op_fuser). Upgrade cuBLAS to 13.8.1 or newer, or disable both "
+        "options."
+    )
+    if os.environ.get(_ALLOW_BUGGY_CUBLAS_GROUPED_GEMM_ENV, "0") == "1":
+        # Message text is constant so the default warning filter shows it once.
+        warnings.warn(message)
+        return
+    raise RuntimeError(
+        f"{message} Set {_ALLOW_BUGGY_CUBLAS_GROUPED_GEMM_ENV}=1 to downgrade this error to a "
+        "warning."
+    )
+
+
 class _VirtualExpertFC2WgradStore:
     """Start the FC2 virtual-expert gradient reduction when TE enqueues FC2's wgrad GEMM.
 
@@ -476,6 +518,8 @@ def __init__(
             self.quantization_unpadding = Fp8Unpadding(
                 self.num_local_experts, align_size=align_size
             )
+        if self._use_grouped_tensor:
+            _check_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_version()
 
     def bind_virtual_experts(self, load_balancer) -> None:
         """Bind native and virtual runtime weights after main gradients are initialized."""

@@ -3,6 +3,7 @@
 import argparse
 import os
 import sys
+import warnings
 from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace
 
 import pytest
@@ -207,6 +208,81 @@ def test_paged_stash_keeps_supported_gtp_grouped_tensor(monkeypatch):
     assert all(linear.use_grouped_tensor is True for linear in grouped_linears)
 
 
+def _mock_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_runtime(monkeypatch, *, capability, cublaslt_version):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "is_available", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "get_device_capability", lambda device=None: capability)
+    monkeypatch.setitem(
+        sys.modules,
+        "transformer_engine_torch",
+        SimpleNamespace(get_cublasLt_version=lambda: cublaslt_version),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.delenv("MCORE_ALLOW_BUGGY_CUBLAS_GROUPED_GEMM", raising=False)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("capability", [(10, 0), (10, 3), (11, 0)], ids=["sm100", "sm103", "sm110"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cublaslt_version", [130700, 130705, 130800], ids=str)
+def test_buggy_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_is_rejected(monkeypatch, capability, cublaslt_version):
+    _mock_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_runtime(
+        monkeypatch, capability=capability, cublaslt_version=cublaslt_version
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="MCORE_ALLOW_BUGGY_CUBLAS_GROUPED_GEMM=1"):
+        experts_module._check_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_version()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "capability,cublaslt_version",
+    [
+        pytest.param((10, 0), 130604, id="sm100-before-bug"),
+        pytest.param((10, 0), 130801, id="sm100-fixed"),
+        pytest.param((10, 0), 130900, id="sm100-newer"),
+        pytest.param((9, 0), 130700, id="sm90-buggy-version"),
+        pytest.param((12, 0), 130700, id="sm120-buggy-version"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_unaffected_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_is_allowed(monkeypatch, capability, cublaslt_version):
+    _mock_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_runtime(
+        monkeypatch, capability=capability, cublaslt_version=cublaslt_version
+    )
+
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("error")
+        experts_module._check_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_version()
+
+
+def test_buggy_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_escape_hatch_warns(monkeypatch):
+    _mock_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_runtime(monkeypatch, capability=(10, 0), cublaslt_version=130700)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MCORE_ALLOW_BUGGY_CUBLAS_GROUPED_GEMM", "1")
+
+    with pytest.warns(UserWarning, match=r"cuBLASLt 13\.7\.0 grouped GEMM"):
+        experts_module._check_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_version()
+
+
+def test_grouped_mlp_rejects_buggy_cublaslt_with_grouped_tensor(monkeypatch):
+    _mock_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_runtime(monkeypatch, capability=(10, 0), cublaslt_version=130700)
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match=r"cuBLASLt 13\.7\.0 grouped GEMM"):
+        _construct_grouped_mlp_with_gtp_weights(
+            monkeypatch,
+            moe_paged_stash=False,
+            te_supports_sharded_weights=True,
+            native_fp8_gather=False,
+        )
+
+
+def test_grouped_mlp_split_quantize_fallback_skips_cublaslt_check(monkeypatch):
+    _mock_cublaslt_grouped_gemm_runtime(monkeypatch, capability=(10, 0), cublaslt_version=130700)
+
+    module, _ = _construct_grouped_mlp_with_gtp_weights(
+        monkeypatch,
+        moe_paged_stash=False,
+        te_supports_sharded_weights=False,
+        native_fp8_gather=False,
+    )
+
+    assert module._use_grouped_tensor is False
+
+
